about_the_game:
Brief

Experience managing a Resort Island while living in and becoming a part of dynamic world.

Build, trade, cook, farm, hunt, ranch, fish, and explore. Fight with your pistol and fists. Survive! All of this serves one goal: The Prosperity of the Resort Island.

Increase your Resort Popularity by providing top-notch service, and raise your Resort Rating by upgrading buildings and furnishings. The better these scores, the more customers you'll attract and the bigger your profits will grow. But beware, the world is wild and unpredictable.

Sail through dangerous waters, uncover shipwrecks, hunt treasures, solve bizarre riddles, and tame tricksters. Manage your Resort Island while dealing with wild encounters.

An Explorer, A Survivor, A Resorter, A Trader... Forge your own destiny.

Make The Resort prosper!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Time marches on - adapt, or fall!

Certain times call for certain duties, like cooking for hungry guests or greeting them with a smile (or at least pretend)!

Haggle - A Risk for Profit!

Negotiate fiercely! Lower prices from traders, raise them for customers. Every coin counts. But beware, haggling comes with the risk of higher costs if unsuccessful.


Furnish - From Sand to Gold!

Decorate and furnish every corner with brand-new props to impress your guests.

Fish - The Ocean Feeds Those Who Dare

Cast your line into the ocean and reel in fresh seafood. Or will something reel you in?


Sailing - The Ocean is Yours!

Carry the customers from other islands to your Resort island. Set sail across the vast, unpredictable sea. Will you return rich… or not at all?

Tips & Tricks

Resort Rating: Upgrade furniture & decorations to increase Resort Rating. A higher rating means higher payments from customers!

Resort Popularity: Deliver top-tier service and keep customers happy to boost your popularity. More popularity = more customers!

Survival: Stay fed, stay hydrated, stay alive. Water wells are free, and fishing is your best bet for a cheap meal!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains occasional violence and blood, combat, sexual content, and suggestive themes.

  • Storage: 19 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Attention: In this game you will encounter a variety of visual effects that may provide seizures or loss of consciousness in a minority of people.
